brand.name: ScholarFlow
brand.tagline: Scholarship application pre-verification that explains problems and routes them for correction

landing.badge: Designed with DPDP principles in mind
landing.heroSubtitle: ScholarFlow provides a pre-verification layer for scholarship applications, replacing vague rejection codes with actionable explanations, regional name matching, and scoped correction links.

features.humaneDesc: Surfaces specific, fixable deficiencies with bilingual explanations rather than opaque rejection notices.
features.securityDesc: Informed by DPDP Act principles: masked Aadhaar storage, in-memory format validation, and guardian consent gates.
features.transparencyDesc: Hash-chained audit log linking state transitions to establish an immutable, verifiable event record.
